visualCharacteristics: Responsive grid of centered profile cards. Each card has a circular avatar image, a name, a role/subtitle, and a centered row of social-media icon links.
contentPattern: One row per person. Each card has an image cell (avatar) and a content cell holding the name (heading), role/subtitle (heading), and a set of social links.
usage: Team, contributor, or guide grids where each item is a person with a photo, name, role, and social links.
